title: Measurement Systems Practice
description: Practice identifying SI units and completing common metric conversion paths.

questions.question: Which unit is a common SI unit for length?
questions.explanation: The meter is the common SI base unit used for length.

questions.question: Convert 4 m to centimeters. Write the number only.
questions.explanation: Meters are larger than centimeters, so multiply by 100: 4 m = 400 cm.

questions.question: Convert 3000 g to kilograms. Write the number only.
questions.explanation: There are 1000 grams in 1 kilogram, so 3000 g divided by 1000 equals 3 kg.

questions.question: When converting from meters to centimeters, the number gets larger because centimeters are smaller units.
questions.explanation: A smaller unit needs more units to describe the same length, so meters to centimeters uses multiplication by 100.

questions.question: Which unit is most appropriate for the capacity of a small water bottle?
questions.explanation: Capacity is measured in liters or milliliters. A small bottle is commonly measured in milliliters.

questions.question: Convert 2.5 L to milliliters. Write the number only.
questions.explanation: There are 1000 milliliters in 1 liter, so 2.5 L = 2500 mL.

questions.question: Explain why 100 cm and 1 m describe the same length.
questions.correctAnswer: They describe the same length because 1 meter is equal to 100 centimeters; the unit changed but the actual distance did not.
questions.explanation: A correct answer should state the conversion fact and explain that converting units does not change the measured amount.
